data.name: Home_Intro
data.value: FormatKit prepares a Windows reinstall and rebuilds the machine afterwards. It checks what could be lost before you format, then installs drivers, programs and settings from a JSON profile.

data.name: Home_Before_Text
data.value: Run the checklist to find what would be lost, and prepare the installation media.

data.name: Home_After_Text
data.value: Run your profile to install drivers and programs and apply your settings.

data.name: Home_Warning
data.value: FormatKit changes the system and can restart the computer. Try it in a virtual machine first.

data.name: Home_Interrupted
data.value: A run was interrupted before it finished. You can resume it where it stopped.
